Dear User

To identify customers underdeveloped versus the national Flavors mix, I need a few clarifications to produce an execution-ready intent:

- Base metric for “mix”: Should the Flavors share be calculated using Unit Cases (volume) or Bottler Net Revenue (NSR)?
  - Option A: Unit Cases (recommended for mix)
  - Option B: NSR

- “Flavors” definition in the product hierarchy: Which governed product attribute contains “Flavors” in your taxonomy?
  - Product Category, Sub-Category, Segment, or a list of Brand Groups (e.g., Sprite, Fanta)?
  - If you know the exact field/value (e.g., Product Segment = “Flavors”), please confirm.

- Time period (445 calendar):
  - Latest completed fiscal month
  - YTD up to the latest available date (latest available is Jan 31 2026)
  - A specific fiscal month/period (please specify)

- Customer grain:
  - ‘Customer’ or ‘Tradename’? Default would be Customer.

- Output scope:
  - Do you want all underdeveloped customers (Flavors mix < national Flavors mix) or the bottom N (e.g., bottom 20 by variance in percentage points)?
  - Any minimum sales threshold to exclude very small customers?

- Filters:
  - Any channel focus (e.g., Modern vs Traditional) or proceed with all channels nationwide (Colombia only)?

Once you confirm these, I will route the intent to retrieve:
- National Flavors mix for the chosen metric and period
- Each customer’s Flavors mix
- Variance to national (pp)
- Supporting totals (e.g., total UC or NSR) for prioritization
